expected.canonical_headline: Vero Beach doubles most parking fines starting Oct. 1, first increase since 2011
expected.canonical_permalink_origin_headline: Vero Beach doubles most parking fines starting Oct. 1, first increase since 2011
selected_headlines: Vero Beach parking fines double Wednesday, with fire lane violations rising to $60
source_headlines: Vero Beach parking fines rising Oct. 1, with some penalties doubling - WPEC
novel_facts: Vero Beach Police Department announced the increases on Sunday Sept. 28
Police urged drivers to review updated fine schedule
Specific enumeration of which violations increase: fire lane, fire hydrant, emergency vehicle zones, traffic obstruction
Police department is now actively communicating the imminent changes three days before Oct. 1 implementation
